english translation text: FAREWELL, OH BELOVED CHILDREN\nOF JAFAR E TAYYAR

arabic text: BINTE ALI YE BACHON SAY KEHTI THI BAAR BAAR
english translation text: THE DAUGHTER OF IMAM ALI AS KEPT TELLING HER CHILDREN...

arabic text: RAN KO SIDHARO AUN-O-MUHAMMAD YE MAA NISAR
english translation text: GO TOWARDS THE BATTLEFIELD AS YOUR MOTHER'S SACRIFICE

arabic text: JAFAR KA IFTEKHAR BHARANA JIHAD MAY
english translation text: MAKE JAFFER E TAYYAR PROUD WHILE YOU FIGHT

arabic text: NANA KI APNI SHAN DIKHANA JIHAD MAY
english translation text: SHOW THE ENEMIES YOUR GRANDFATHER’S (IMAM ALI AS) CHIVALRY WHILE YOU FIGHT

arabic text: SHAIR-E-KHUDA KI BETI KAY TUM DONO SHAIR HO
english translation text: BOTH OF YOU ARE THE LIONS OF THE DAUGHTER OF THE LION OF GOD (IMAM ALI AS)

arabic text: MAIDAN MAY JAWO FATHA MAI AB KUCH NA DAIR HO
english translation text: RUSH TO THE BATTLEFIELD AND DO NOT DELAY VICTORY

arabic text: BACHO ZAEEF MAMU KO ZEHMAT NA DEEJIYO
english translation text: O MY CHILDREN! PLEASE DO NOT BE A BURDEN ON YOUR TIRED UNCLE ( IMAM HUSSAIN AS)

arabic text: LASHAY UTHAAYE BHAI TO JUMBISH NA KIJIYO
english translation text: STAY STILL WHEN MY BROTHER CARRIES YOUR BODIES

arabic text: PYAASE JO AAOGE TO SILA DEGI TUM KO MAA
english translation text: YOUR MOTHER WILL REWARD YOU IF YOU COME BACK THIRSTY

arabic text: KHUD DAUD KAR GALLAY SAY LAGA LEGI MAA
english translation text: YOUR MOTHER WILL HERSELF RUN AND EMBRACE YOU
